Peace with the Lizards

The Lizard Hermit asks you to place the Great Shell on the lizard altar in the Distant Mountains. This should bring peace with the humans who have been raiding lizard lands. In return, the Hermit promises to explain how to find the Chosen One.

Objectives

Go to the altar

Place the shell

Locations

Maps
Distant Mountains

Authored rewards

PropertyValue
Experience600.0
Gold4500.0

These are the authored base rewards. Scripts, choices and game rules can change the final reward.
